title: A quick glance: find the one thing that needs me, and who is waiting on whom
goal: Open Home and find, in under a minute, the one thing that needs me and who is waiting on whom.

persona.name: keyboard-glance
persona.story: You know this app a little. You want the answer in as few steps as possible. You use the keyboard, you read little, and you stop when you have the answer.

steps.say: Find the way to what is waiting on me
Open the first thing waiting on me
